items.description: Fat-face contrast × depth-sized open pearl masses

items.title: 33 · NATIVE / RAIL GRID
items.description: Extra-condensed serif lettering × open parallel rails and cross-joints

items.title: 34 · REWARD / SPLIT MOSAIC
items.description: The established REWARD trace × opposing quarter-disc mosaic cells

items.title: 35 · TUMIN / BRICK LOOPS
items.description: Heavy lowercase Egyptian shapes × connected staggered rounded bricks

items.title: 36 · TUSCAN / TOPO LINES
items.description: Condensed Tuscan slab heads, thin waists and narrow counters × Layered open contour lines inspired by modern modular line lettering. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 37 · FATFACE / STENCIL GRID
items.description: Wide fatface mass, heavy verticals and fine horizontal joins × Pixel stencil cells with square white cuts and open counters. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 38 · EGYPTIAN / GRADED TILES
items.description: Narrow Egyptian slab construction, strong horizontal caps and feet × Tile modules sized to real stroke depth, after the Rajola modular principle. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 39 · FATFACE / CRESCENT CELLS
items.description: Broad heavy bowls and compact contrasting joins × Rounded cellular fragments inspired by playful modern modular execution. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 40 · WOODTYPE / CORNER JOINTS
items.description: Rectangular slab heads, sturdy stems and compact woodtype proportions × Rotating angular corner units inspired by pixel/grid construction. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 41 · WAISTED / PEARL CONTRAST
items.description: Very condensed slab heads, tapered vertical waists and narrow counters × Large beads in heavy areas, small beads in thin joins, after Cafe and Robbie. Original structural interpretation, not an archival trace.

items.title: 01 · SKELETON CHAINS
items.description: Light / single chains follow the original stroke centerlines.

items.title: 02 · STROKE-AWARE DOTS
items.description: Contrast / dots reconstruct the original thick and thin stroke areas.

items.title: 03 · DOTTED CONTOURS
items.description: Architectural / dots trace the original outer edges and counters.

items.title: 04 · PETAL CLUSTERS
items.description: Four-dot floral modules reconstruct the stroke mass.

items.title: 05 · GRADED DOT MASS
items.description: Large dots in thick cores; finer dots toward the edges.

items.title: 06 · SPINE + SATELLITES
items.description: A strong central chain with small dots in wider stroke regions.

items.title: 07 · ALTERNATING CADENCE
items.description: A repeating large/small rhythm inside the original strokes.

items.title: 08 · RING DOTS
items.description: The 02 stroke-aware placement rebuilt with open circular modules.

items.title: 09 · BOLD CORE / FINE EDGE
items.description: Substantial dots in heavy strokes; delicate dotted boundaries.

items.title: 10 · ORBIT KNOTS
items.description: Open rings alternate with solid knots along the real stroke skeleton.

items.title: 11 · PEARL RIBBONS
items.description: Continuous rounded ribbons with a fine inset and regularly interrupted pearl chain.

items.title: 12 · MIDNIGHT BLOOMS
items.description: A chain of six-petal flowers expands and contracts around the reference letter strokes.

items.title: 13 · SCAN / PUNCTURE
items.description: Striped stroke mass, alternating bar weights, and black punctuation around the contour.

items.title: 14 · TIDAL RIBBONS
items.description: Wavy horizontal ribbons flow through the original positive mass and counters.

items.title: 15 · OFF REGISTER
items.description: Three offset granular impressions combine as one black ink; their geometry stays separate.

items.title: 16 · CONSTELLATION
items.description: The stroke network becomes celestial links, bright nodes, and four-point stars.

items.title: 17 · WOVEN STITCH
items.description: Alternating diagonal stitches form a textile-like mass instead of circular rails.

items.title: 18 · BUBBLE FOAM
items.description: Irregular circles pack inside the real ink; broad strokes contain large bubbles and fine ones.

items.title: 19 · CRESCENT CELLS
items.description: Small crescent modules and bright satellites create a directional, open-cell texture.

items.title: 20 · PRISM FACETS
items.description: The same triangular facets in one black ink: adjacent pieces merge visually toward solid mass.

items.title: 21 · LOOSE CONFETTI
items.description: Anchored pearl skeleton with jittered small dots and a few escaping fragments.

items.title: 22 · DEPTH PEARLS
items.description: Circular pearls swell inside heavy stems and taper through thin joins.

items.title: 23 · GRADED LOZENGES
items.description: Diamond modules enlarge with local stroke depth; tiny gems retain fine details.

items.title: 24 · SOFT MOSAIC
items.description: Rounded square tiles grow through broad slabs and shrink toward thin strokes.

items.title: 25 · BLOOM MASS
items.description: Four-lobed flowers become broad blooms in deep ink and buds in narrow connectors.

items.title: 26 · TUSCAN TRIADS
items.description: Alternating triangular modules scale to the measured space within each stroke.

items.title: 27 · DEPTH HALOS
items.description: Ring diameter and wall width increase with the available original stroke thickness.

items.title: 28 · WAIST CAPSULES
items.description: Horizontal oval modules become wider inside heavy strokes, with fine beads at joins.

items.title: 29 · HONEYCOMB CONTRAST
items.description: Hexagonal cells expand across heavy ink and reduce to tiny facets in delicate strokes.
